unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Representative cytometry exports, instrument-specific cofactors, large event sets, scientific benchmarking, and human-expert review have not been evaluated.
The self-test uses a synthetic three-channel table and checks arithmetic, determinism, strict numeric parsing, create-new pair publication, and rollback boundaries only.
FCS parsing, compensation, cofactor selection or estimation, logicle and biexponential transforms, gating, labeling, QC decisions, and biological interpretation are outside the package.
Same-directory hostile-writer races and Windows publication and symlink behavior were not evaluated.
A rare failure after a temporary name is created but before its inode identity is recorded may leave a hidden mode-0600 staged file.
Cross-platform floating-point byte identity was not established.

decision_sequence.applies_when: A selected channel lacks an explicit positive cofactor or the selected-channel identity is ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Which predeclared positive cofactor belongs to each selected event channel?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use the instrument or analysis-plan approved channel-to-cofactor mapping; do not estimate values from this event table.

runtime_versions: Python 3.12.8 self-test; compatible syntax requires Python >=3.10

runtime_verification.reason: Only a deterministic synthetic helper self-test was run; this is not formal agent runtime evaluation or representative cytometry validation.
